messages.text: Two new structuring alerts out of BSAWatch this morning. First is {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0071}}: four cash deposits into {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00154}} in six days, each between $8,200 and $9,400. Second is {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0080}}, operating account. Pulling detail on both now.
Thanks Monica. Is the c_0071 pattern new, or does it match their history? Risk rating is low, so I want to know if this is a real departure from baseline.

Real departure. The prior 12 months were mostly payroll direct deposit through ACHHub, with maybe one small cash deposit a quarter. Now it's about $34,700 in cash in six days, spread across two branches.
Two branches is the part I don't love. Check the teller notes in MemberCRM for any explanation given at the window, like source of funds or a sale.

On {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0080}}: five cash deposits into {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00170}} over eight business days, every one just under $10k, about $46,000 total. Commercial client since 2022, low risk. Could be retail cash intake, but the amounts are oddly uniform.
Quick question from me: are these two alerts connected in any way? I don't want us overreacting on a long-standing business, but I also don't want an exam finding.

No link so far, Gloria. Different branches, different profiles. We're reviewing each on its own merits. Cash intake isn't unusual for a business, but we'll test it against expected activity from onboarding.
Checked the onboarding profile: expected monthly cash was around $15k. This is roughly 3x that in under two weeks, and the deposits sit just under the CTR threshold every single time.
That supports opening a full case. Request branch and teller notes, and ask Rita Jimenez for context on the business before anyone goes near the client.
On it. Reaching out to Rita now. Reminder to everyone in here: no conversations with either client about these alerts. No tipping off.
Understood. Keep me posted on whether a SAR looks likely. I'll stay out of any client conversations.

Update: Jonathan says {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0071}} told him the cash came from selling equipment, but there's no documentation yet. I'm requesting it through the standard review process and logging everything in the case file.
Good. If the docs don't corroborate by Friday, we move toward a SAR decision ahead of the 30-day mark. Document the timeline carefully either way.
